# fln

> A local, explainable context compiler for AI coding agents. Retrieval without embeddings. Context without a server.

fln analyzes a codebase, plans what to include, and emits one AI-ready file (md/json) with diagnostics. Think tsc for LLM context: analyze → plan → emit.

Important notes:
- Local-first: no embeddings, no network during flatten / why / doctor / plan / diff / mcp. Exception: `fln upgrade`.
- CLI + namespace API only: `fln()`, `.inspect()`, `.explain()`, `.doctor()`, `.plan()`, `.diff()`, `.mcp()`. Node ≥22 (ESM) or standalone binary.
- Key commands: `fln`, `fln plan`, `fln why <path>`, `fln doctor`, `fln diff`, `fln mcp`, `fln init`, `fln upgrade`.
- Filtering: `-e` exclude, `-i`/`--stdin` force-include, `--only`/`--since`/`--ext` whitelist; secrets never embedded even with force-include.

Last reviewed: 2026-07-14

## Docs

- [README](https://github.com/nesvet/fln#readme): Human landing page — install, workflows, CLI/API reference
- [AGENTS.md](https://github.com/nesvet/fln/blob/main/AGENTS.md): Architecture, invariants (namespace API, single-pass I/O, FlnError), contributor rules for agents
- [SECURITY.md](https://github.com/nesvet/fln/blob/main/SECURITY.md): Secret detection scope and limits (not a guarantee)
- [CONTRIBUTING.md](https://github.com/nesvet/fln/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md): Setup, `bun run verify`, PR expectations
- [Install](https://fln.nesvet.dev/install): curl/PowerShell install scripts for standalone binaries
- [npm package](https://www.npmjs.com/package/fln): Published package for Node/Bun (`npx fln`, `import { fln }`)

## Schemas

- [fln.json config](https://fln.nesvet.dev/schema): JSON Schema for project config (`fln init`)
- [plan](https://fln.nesvet.dev/schema/plan): `fln plan --format json` / `toFlnPlanJson`
- [output](https://fln.nesvet.dev/schema/output): Flatten JSON (`fln --format json`)
- [doctor](https://fln.nesvet.dev/schema/doctor): `fln doctor --format json` / `toFlnDoctorJson`
- [diff](https://fln.nesvet.dev/schema/diff): `fln diff --format json` / `toFlnDiffJson`

## Examples

- [examples/](https://github.com/nesvet/fln/tree/main/examples): Sample flatten outputs (TypeScript, Python, Go, Rust, Java)
- [demo plan](https://github.com/nesvet/fln/blob/main/assets/demo-plan.md): Checked-in `fln plan --relevant` sample against this repo
